comments.author: kcudnik
comments.body:
Iif we look at syslog, then we can see *a lot* of  messages from internal bcm:
Oct 13 06:33:25.529002 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 INFO syncd#syncd: [0] SAI_API_FDB:_brcm_sai_fdb_event_cb:57 FDB event: 1 for mac 98-03-9B-03-22-00 vid:0x3e8, port:0x2d lagid:0x0 flags:0x10440 flags2:0x0 lag:false
Oct 13 06:33:25.545438 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 INFO syncd#syncd: [0] SAI_API_FDB:_brcm_sai_fdb_event_cb:57 FDB event: 0 for mac 98-03-9B-03-22-00 vid:0x3e8, port:0x0 lagid:0x0 flags:0x9f4468 flags2:0x0 lag:false
Oct 13 06:33:25.545438 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 INFO syncd#syncd: [0] SAI_API_FDB:_brcm_sai_fdb_event_cb:57 FDB event: 1 for mac 98-03-9B-03-22-00 vid:0x3e8, port:0x39 lagid:0x0 flags:0x1f0440 flags2:0x0 lag:false

This particular mac address is jumping from port to port like over 20 times per second, in syslog you attached, during 2.5min time span, this message pops up 9500 times!
Is that part of the unittest ? or could be some switch/sai internal issue ?

Then we can see about 4500 logs like this:
Oct 13 06:33:26.622762 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 WARNING syncd#syncd: :- check_fdb_event_notification_data: RID 0x1003a00000000 on SAI_FDB_ENTRY_ATTR_BRIDGE_PORT_ID is not present on local ASIC DB

Each fdb_event notification syncd will receive, it checks all OIDs (RIDs) in that notifications, if every RID is present in Redis database, this means whether it was previously created or discovered,
Here, RID value (0x1003a00000000) which is in all notification, is not present in redis db, or was discovered, value 0x3a in oid suggest that this item is dec 58, SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_BRIDGE_PORT
Here it would be helpful to have dump on VIDTORID table from redis database with this command:
redis-cli -n 1 "hgetall" "RIDTOVID"
so we could see what are defined RID values for bridge ports, and to see/figure out whether actual value 0x1003a00000000 is correct,

Three also sylog limit kicked in:
Oct 13 06:34:41.014333 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 INFO syncd#rsyslogd: imuxsock[pid: 41, name: /usr/bin/syncd]: 3459 messages lost due to rate-limiting

If everything is ok, we should not get those warnings that oid is not present in asic db, take a look at those logs, and here is my prediction what's happening:
Oct 13 06:33:25.561177 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 INFO syncd#syncd: [0] SAI_API_FDB:_brcm_sai_fdb_event_cb:57 FDB event: 0 for mac 98-03-9B-03-22-00 vid:0x3e8, port:0x0 lagid:0x0 flags:0x1f446c flags2:0x0 lag:false
Oct 13 06:33:25.561177 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 INFO syncd#syncd: [0] SAI_API_FDB:_brcm_sai_fdb_event_cb:57 FDB event: 1 for mac 98-03-9B-03-22-00 vid:0x3e8, port:0x5 lagid:0x0 flags:0x1f0440 flags2:0x0 lag:false
Oct 13 06:33:25.561177 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 WARNING syncd#syncd: :- check_fdb_event_notification_data: RID 0x1003a00000000 on SAI_FDB_ENTRY_ATTR_BRIDGE_PORT_ID is not present on local ASIC DB
Oct 13 06:33:25.566333 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 INFO syncd#syncd: [0] SAI_API_FDB:_brcm_sai_fdb_event_cb:57 FDB event: 0 for mac 98-03-9B-03-22-00 vid:0x3e8, port:0x0 lagid:0x0 flags:0x9f4440 flags2:0x0 lag:false
Oct 13 06:33:25.566333 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 INFO syncd#syncd: [0] SAI_API_FDB:_brcm_sai_fdb_event_cb:57 FDB event: 1 for mac 98-03-9B-03-22-00 vid:0x3e8, port:0x1d lagid:0x0 flags:0x1f0440 flags2:0x0 lag:false
Oct 13 06:33:25.566952 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 WARNING syncd#syncd: :- check_fdb_event_notification_data: RID 0x1003a00000000 on SAI_FDB_ENTRY_ATTR_BRIDGE_PORT_ID is not present on local ASIC DB
Oct 13 06:33:25.571290 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 INFO syncd#syncd: [0] SAI_API_FDB:_brcm_sai_fdb_event_cb:57 FDB event: 0 for mac 98-03-9B-03-22-00 vid:0x3e8, port:0x0 lagid:0x0 flags:0x9f4464 flags2:0x0 lag:false
Oct 13 06:33:25.571290 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 INFO syncd#syncd: [0] SAI_API_FDB:_brcm_sai_fdb_event_cb:57 FDB event: 1 for mac 98-03-9B-03-22-00 vid:0x3e8, port:0x47 lagid:0x0 flags:0x1f0440 flags2:0x0 lag:false
Oct 13 06:33:25.571290 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 WARNING syncd#syncd: :- check_fdb_event_notification_data: RID 0x1003a00000000 on SAI_FDB_ENTRY_ATTR_BRIDGE_PORT_ID is not present on local ASIC DB

As you can see mac address 98-03-9B-03-22-00 is jumping (assuming event 0 aged, and event 1 is learned  according to SAI brcm sdk) for many different ports,
I’m guessing here that value “port:0x0” is invalid value for port in brcm SAI internals, and that value is used to construct RID 0x1003a00000000, which came out to be invalid, this is my guess 

Of course this mac jumping doesn’t seem normal to me, unless this is what our test is doing, here is next question, this unittests where you see this jumping, what tests is exactly perform?

Next from sairedis .40 and .39, if we combine them, since they are continuation, we can see that .40 is ok, but it has fdb_flush api called:
2020-10-13.06:31:56.915366|f|SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_FDB_FLUSH:oid:0x21000000000000|
2020-10-13.06:32:06.370196|F|SAI_STATUS_SUCCESS

And right after that we can see flood of fdb_events with mac address: "98:03:9B:03:22:00”
2020-10-13.06:33:25.529600|n|fdb_event|[{"fdb_entry":"{\"bvid\":\"oid:0x2600000000060d\",\"mac\":\"98:03:9B:03:22:00\",\"switch_id\":\"oid:0x21000000000000\"}","fdb_event":"SAI_FDB_EVENT_LEARNED","list":[{"id":"SAI_FDB_ENTRY_ATTR_BRIDGE_PORT_ID","value":"oid:0x3a00000000061e"}]}]|
2020-10-13.06:33:25.547397|n|fdb_event|[{"fdb_entry":"{\"bvid\":\"oid:0x2600000000060d\",\"mac\":\"98:03:9B:03:22:00\",\"switch_id\":\"oid:0x21000000000000\"}","fdb_event":"SAI_FDB_EVENT_LEARNED","list":[{"id":"SAI_FDB_ENTRY_ATTR_BRIDGE_PORT_ID","value":"oid:0x3a000000000624"}]}]|
2020-10-13.06:33:25.562826|n|fdb_event|[{"fdb_entry":"{\"bvid\":\"oid:0x2600000000060d\",\"mac\":\"98:03:9B:03:22:00\",\"switch_id\":\"oid:0x21000000000000\"}","fdb_event":"SAI_FDB_EVENT_LEARNED","list":[{"id":"SAI_FDB_ENTRY_ATTR_BRIDGE_PORT_ID","value":"oid:0x3a00000000061a"}]}]|
2020-10-13.06:33:25.570081|n|fdb_event|[{"fdb_entry":"{\"bvid\":\"oid:0x2600000000060d\",\"mac\":\"98:03:9B:03:22:00\",\"switch_id\":\"oid:0x21000000000000\"}","fdb_event":"SAI_FDB_EVENT_LEARNED","list":[{"id":"SAI_FDB_ENTRY_ATTR_BRIDGE_PORT_ID","value":"oid:0x3a000000000616"}]}]|
…

Which is learned on ALL ports, we don’t see recording of AGED event, since in syslog we can see that AGED event contains invalid port number (my suspected 0x0 port)
And via entire sairedis.39 recording we can see start from:
2020-10-13.06:31:56.915366|f|SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_FDB_FLUSH:oid:0x21000000000000|
2020-10-13.06:32:06.370196|F|SAI_STATUS_SUCCESS
2020-10-13.06:33:25.529600|n|fdb_event|[{"fdb_entry":"{\"bvid\":\"oid:0x2600000000060d\",\"mac\":\"98:03:9B:03:22:00\",\"switch_id\":\"oid:0x21000000000000\"}","fdb_event":"SAI_FDB_EVENT_LEARNED","list":[{"id":"SAI_FDB_ENTRY_ATTR_BRIDGE_PORT_ID","value":"oid:0x3a00000000061e"}]}]|
And end on:
2020-10-13.06:34:53.090561|n|fdb_event|[{"fdb_entry":"{\"bvid\":\"oid:0x2600000000060d\",\"mac\":\"98:03:9B:03:22:00\",\"switch_id\":\"oid:0x21000000000000\"}","fdb_event":"SAI_FDB_EVENT_LEARNED","list":[{"id":"SAI_FDB_ENTRY_ATTR_BRIDGE_PORT_ID","value":"oid:0x3a000000000620"}]}]|

And there are 5422 events of learning this specific MAC on all ports, jumping all over the place all time, in my opinion, fdb flush triggered something ether with switch/asic itself on in SAI brcm sdk internally, since for this particular mac those notifications are generated constantly learned/aged for all bridge ports 

This will need investigation by Broadcom team what’s happening exactly 
Worth noticing that those fdb_event notifications start popping up after 1min and 19sec after flush
This is visible in recordings and syslog

From sairedis/syncd perspective there is nothing wrong

linkedPullRequests.title: Upgrade to SAI BCM 4.2.1.5-6 to pick up the fib hash patch (CS0001138…
linkedPullRequests.author: gechiang
linkedPullRequests.body:
…8674) and the fdb invalid port patch (CS00011298546)

**- Why I did it**
In SAI 4.2.1.5 there are two issues discovered by nightly test:
1. FIB Hashing issue where it does not evenly distribute to all LAG members and thus causing fib test failure.  A patch to address this issue was provided by BRCM (CS00011388674) and validated with a private build.
2. FDB event has invalid port, flooding syslog with error messages.  A patch to address this was also provided by BRCM (CS00011298546) and validated with a private build. 

**- How to verify it**
For the fib hash issue please refer to (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/5681).
For the FDB invalid port issue please refer to (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/5616).

**- Description for the changelog**
Moving BRCM SAI 4.2.1.5 to 4.2.1.5-6 to pick up fix for FIB Hashing issue (CS00011388674) and FDB Invalid Port issue (CS00011298546).

Fixes #5681 
Fixes #5616
